pages.text: A white hole only emits. But it is unstable (Eardley): any matter falling toward it piles up at its horizon until it collapses into a black hole. Keep the chamber vacuum hard and the outflow strong enough to sweep it away.
$(thing)Set$(): White hole mass, Outflow rate, Chamber vacuum, Confinement field.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Chamber outgassing: the residual gas pressure fluctuates by a factor 10^(0.3·d).

$(thing)Limits$(): Super-Eddington outflow batters the containment; Radiation pressure exceeds the magnetic pressure: blow-out; Interlock: confinement coils not superconducting (too warm); Field above the critical field: the confinement coils quench.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Ejecta production follows the outflow.

$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Luminosity: L = 0.1·ṁc²$(br)Luminosity: log₁₀ L$(br)Eddington luminosity: L_Edd = 4πGMm_p c/σ_T$(br)Eddington ratio: L/L_Edd$(br)Infall rate: ṁ_in ∝ P·M²$(br)Radiation pressure: p = L/(4πr²c)$(br)Magnetic pressure: p = B²/2μ₀
